# LAST LIGHT recorded effects

These recordings are bundled under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The Freesound entries below are the original uploaders' pages and identify each recording as CC0. The game uses edited excerpts of their public audio previews. Edits include trimming, fades, filtering, level matching, pitch shifts on creature sounds, crossfaded room-tone loops and AAC encoding.

- `creature-alert.m4a` and `creature-grab.m4a` use non-verbal actor performances from Archeos, with an undertone from nielstii's wildlife recording. [Man screaming.wav](https://freesound.org/people/Archeos/sounds/325548/) · [Fox scream in the forest](https://freesound.org/people/nielstii/sounds/554308/)
- `creature-howl.m4a` layers a recorded and processed human growl by waxsocks with the same fox recording. [Roar.wav](https://freesound.org/people/waxsocks/sounds/410343/) · [Fox scream in the forest](https://freesound.org/people/nielstii/sounds/554308/)
- `creature-growl.m4a` comes from Breviceps. [Zombie moan 2](https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/445994/)
- `creature-exhale.m4a` comes from otherthings. [Exhale_10115a.wav](https://freesound.org/people/otherthings/sounds/65619/)
- `step-stone.m4a` contains three recorded steps by Fission9. [Hiking Boot Footsteps on Stone](https://freesound.org/people/Fission9/sounds/521590/)
- `step-grate.m4a` contains three recorded steps by IENBA. [Footsteps on Metal](https://freesound.org/people/IENBA/sounds/698697/)
- `step-carpet.m4a` contains three recorded steps by tvilgiat. [Footsteps in the Hallway 3](https://freesound.org/people/tvilgiat/sounds/472660/)
- `door-steel.m4a` combines the opening and closing transients of a real industrial door by pagancow. [Metal_push door open.wav](https://freesound.org/people/pagancow/sounds/15315/)
- `room-boiler.m4a` comes from blaukreuz's machinery recording. [Utility room rear](https://freesound.org/people/blaukreuz/sounds/212780/)
- `room-office.m4a` comes from mbezzola's technical room ventilation recording. [Room tone air conditioning equipment 3](https://freesound.org/people/mbezzola/sounds/652475/)
- `room-roof.m4a` comes from PostProdDog's outdoor stereo field recording. [traffic passes and wind gusts blow the autumn leaves ambience](https://freesound.org/people/PostProdDog/sounds/537329/)

Each pursuer uses the credited actor and field recordings above. Live playback varies the attack, breath, pitch and foley for the individual pursuer. The howl layers in a lower throat take. The lunge has a cloth drag and a short metal fitting rattle, and the close attack adds two movements of fabric. These additional layers and the three knocks behind the boiler service hatch are synthesized in the game.

- `mourning-sob-soft.m4a` and `mourning-sob-held.m4a` are two excerpts of AlucardsBride’s [crying woman.wav](https://freesound.org/people/AlucardsBride/sounds/172738/), published under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The verified [Wikimedia source copy](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cry_of_woman.ogg) was trimmed, level matched and encoded as mono AAC so the game can position the breaths.

Both editions use three non-verbal human recordings for Eli's gasp, chase breathing and return to the checkpoint. Named game dialogue is credited separately in the [dialogue credits](../assets/dialogue/CREDITS.md).
